title: Copy import link
intro: Whoever opens this link gets Add provider filled in with {name}'s address and models, and saves it themselves.
fit_ids: The model list is too long for a link, so it brings only the model IDs.
fit_none: The model list is too long for a link, so whoever opens it fetches the models.
paste: Someone with their own hub can paste the link into Add provider › Paste a configuration.
key_switch: Put a key in the link
key_switch_hint: Otherwise whoever opens it types their own key.
key_invalid: A key has no spaces or line breaks.
key_warning: Anyone who gets this link can use this key. Links pass through chat apps, browsers and their history, and can't be taken back. Use a key you can revoke, with a spending limit, and send it only to people you trust.
link_waits: The import link opens when you close this.
